items.title: James Moody interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: Gordé? Boy that was an experience to see that. You know, see that man.

ctx.x: G-O-R-D- with the thing over the E, the hyphen over the E? That’s where the slaves shipped off from? Gordé? Boy that was an experience to see that. You know, see that man. But being with Diz was wonderful, because you’d go places, we’d be in Yugoslavia, Czechoslovakia, I mean at the time, and Hungary. You know in Hungary, you know Buda and Pest are two separate places?
Buda and Pest are two separate—
